<!-- wg-report cycle=2026-11-26 group=wg:third-party-ready -->
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-25 11:30 to 2026-11-26 11:30 UTC
Paused: 2 reports unacknowledged (11-24 and 11-25 carry no 👍). Receive in a session or react 👍 to resume. The group builds and merges nothing new while paused; reviews and escalations continue.

1. Decisions for you: one escalation is open and waits on you: srs#965, proposed decision f0c64ba4 (asked by the analyst 11-25). Fact: a corpus at dataModelRevision 0 or 1 gets `storage-generation-unsupported` today, but revisions 2 to 9 get `container-migration-needed`. Why it matters: a person with an old corpus is told two different things to do. Options: A keep both codes; B one code for every corpus a migration can reach (recommended). Action needed: decide. Urgency: low, no PR waits on it. Still waiting from earlier: the five Door 3 revisions srs#1033 to #1037 carry `gate:owner-merge`; ruling de6b88c5 (ratified 11-24) lets a revision that only executes a ratified ruling carry `gate:auto-merge`. Relabel or merge them (inform). Urgency: they still hold the ready queue.

2. Decided within mandate: none this cycle. No PR merged, so no builder decision was ready and no group session was held.

3. Done: 0 PRs merged this cycle (the last, srs-rust#1710, merged 11-25 01:28 UTC, in the previous cycle's window). No tasks closed.

4. Stuck or lost: srs#1021 (conflicts since 11-12) and srs#1049 (conflicts since 11-22) are `dirty`, a third cycle without a rebase; srs#1035 and #1036 (owner-merge) are `dirty` too; srs#1033, #1034, #1037 and #1052 are `unstable` (checks not green or still running), and #1033 to #1037 wait on you; srs-rust#1646 and #1709 are `behind` master with no review comment, and #1646 has not moved since 11-11. The group is paused, so none is being rebased. No red gate reported by a run. Needs-input unchanged: srs-rust#1495, #1164, #731, #728, #1510; srs-web#691, #632; srs#965 (new, see 1). Escalation-log check (owner rulings in both logs): not re-read this cycle.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 5 open delegated (srs#1021, #1049, #1052, srs-rust#1646, #1709); room 5. Pause state: paused: 2 reports unacknowledged.
5b. Awaiting ratification: f0c64ba4 only, the escalation in 1 (proposed 11-25, 1 day). It is the owner's to decide. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: workable ready issues: srs-rust 2 by label (#1692 field filters decimals, P0; #1677 move guidance into srs-mcp-core) plus the rest blocked or needs-input; srs 0; srs-vscode 0; srs-web 0 workable. Top 3 in Builder order: srs-rust#1692, #1677, then #1679 (blocked). Open group PRs in flight: 5 delegated and 5 Door 3. Budget left: 5, but the group is paused. **Queue running dry in effect: about 2 workable, budget 10. Needs feeding, and a 👍 to unpause.** New work could come from the spec-to-implementation drift list or open exercises. Fed by the analyst: 11-25: filed 0, unparked 2, rulings asked 1, 2 workable once board-sync promotes the `promote:ready` ones.
6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle.

7. What we learned: the pause is the new fact. Two reports in a row went unreacted, so the group stopped, while the cause of the dry queue (Door 3 PRs waiting on you, and a ruling ratified without anyone applying it) is unchanged for three reports. Pattern to watch: a ruling ratified with no step that applies it. Measurement I1 (cf1a7223, evidenced from this report): 0 of 0 PRs in its window, which again opens at the 11:30 cycleStart and so covers nothing (the script needs the close time, not now; flagged since 11-22). Whether I1 is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending. Build trigger (srs-web#560): ready to unpark (well over 10 ratified decisions). Flow stop: #31 is still at its 100 sub-issue cap (finding 92162b10).
